i.what: validation maps inside the floor band
i.note: needs the second reference draw and the validation set

ii.what: disjoint 4-episode subsets agree within 10% (median over pairs), and a map's copy in another corpus lands where its primary point does; maps inside the floor band are reported, not judged

iii.what: the two reference draws rank the maps alike

iv.what: arenas 6 to 8 (the training WAD) sit nearer than every campaign map

v.what: |Spearman(D, Kish n_eff)| over the primary maps, motion arm

bootstrap.what: median bootstrap SD of D over the SD of D across primary maps; under 0.1 the attenuation of a correlation with D is below 1 percent

bootstrap_full.what: the bootstrap of D itself: episodes redrawn with replacement, then as many 4-episode subsets averaged as D averages; median SD over the SD of D across primary maps
